articles.summary: Purchase expands non-medical product offerings and technology serving small and midsize employers The Hartford completed its acquisition of Equitable’s 1 Employee Benefits business, which represents approximately $500 million in premium in non-medical benefits and Equitable’s Employee Benefits technology. articles.title: The Hartford Closes Acquisition Of Equitable’s Employee Benefits Business
